name: Nhảy – theo video mẫu
content:
Create a realistic full-body dance video using the provided reference image as the primary visual source.
IMPORTANT: Preserve the exact identity and appearance of the person from the reference image.
FACE AND IDENTITY:

Keep the exact same face, facial structure, eyes, nose, lips, skin tone and hairstyle.
Do not redesign, beautify, replace or reinterpret the face.
The person's identity must remain consistent throughout the entire video.
No face morphing, no face swapping, no identity change.
Facial features must remain stable during movement and camera motion.
BODY AND CLOTHING:

Preserve the person's body proportions, physique, clothing, colors, shoes and accessories from the reference image.
Do not change or redesign the outfit.
Do not add or remove accessories.
Keep the same person throughout the entire video.
BACKGROUND AND ENVIRONMENT:

Preserve the original background, location, architecture, objects, colors, lighting and overall environment from the reference image.
Do not replace the background with a different environment.
Do not generate a new location.
Do not add unnecessary objects or people.
The background should remain visually consistent throughout the video.
ACTION:

Animate the person performing a natural, energetic dance.
Keep the person's appearance unchanged while allowing realistic body movement.
Full-body dancing with both feet and the entire body visible.
Natural human anatomy and realistic motion.
Realistic hands, fingers, arms and legs.
CAMERA:

Keep the camera relatively stable.
Use subtle cinematic camera movement only.
Do not excessively zoom in on the face.
Keep the person fully visible for most of the video.
VISUAL CONSISTENCY:
The reference image is the source of truth for the person's identity, appearance, clothing and environment.
Do not reinterpret the reference image.
Do not change the person, face, outfit or location.
QUALITY:
Photorealistic video, natural skin texture, realistic human motion, consistent lighting, realistic physics, detailed face and hands.
Avoid:
face distortion, identity change, different person, different hairstyle, different clothes, different background, new location, extra people, extra limbs, missing limbs, deformed hands, duplicated body parts, unnatural anatomy, background replacement, flickering objects, sudden scene changes.

name: Quần áo – người mẫu trình diễn
content:
Create a fashion advertisement video for the outfit "{{product_name}}".
The person in the provided image is the model; keep the exact same face, hairstyle, body and outfit.
The outfit must look EXACTLY like in the image: same cut, fabric, colors, patterns and details.
ACTION: the model walks toward the camera like on a runway, turns slowly, poses to show the outfit,
touches the fabric lightly to show its texture.
CAMERA: full-body shot, smooth tracking, ends with a medium shot highlighting the outfit details.
SCENE: clean bright studio with soft light, minimal background.
QUALITY:
Photorealistic commercial video, natural lighting, realistic physics, sharp product details.
Avoid: distorted product, wrong logo or text, changed colors, extra limbs, deformed hands,
duplicated objects, flickering, sudden scene changes, watermarks, on-screen text.

name: túi xách
content:
Create a premium fashion commercial video using the provided female model image as the character reference and the provided white HAPAS handbag image as the exact product reference.
Character consistency: Keep the same woman's facial identity, hairstyle, body proportions, skin tone, and overall appearance throughout the entire video. Do not change her face between shots.
Product consistency: The handbag must remain exactly consistent with the reference image: elegant white structured rectangular handbag, white top handles, detachable white shoulder strap, gold metal hardware, hanging HAPAS tag and gold HAPAS logo. Do not alter the bag's shape, proportions, color, handles, logo, accessories, stitching, or hardware.
Change the model's original casual outfit into an elegant outfit that matches the white luxury handbag: a sophisticated feminine look in ivory, cream, beige, champagne or soft neutral tones. Use a fitted elegant sleeveless top or blouse combined with a flowing midi skirt or tailored high-waisted trousers, minimal gold jewelry, and elegant neutral heels. The styling should feel modern, clean, luxurious and suitable for a premium handbag advertisement.
Change the background into a refined fashion-show environment that complements the handbag: a luxurious minimalist cream and beige studio with soft architectural curves, warm diffused lighting, subtle shadows, polished light floor, and an elegant runway atmosphere. Keep the background uncluttered so the white handbag remains the visual focus.
Scene 1 – Introduction: Full-body shot. The woman stands elegantly in the center of the scene while holding the handbag naturally at her side. She looks toward the camera and gives a warm, confident, natural smile. Her posture is graceful and relaxed. Slow cinematic camera push-in.
Scene 2 – Product presentation: The woman gently raises the handbag to approximately chest height and presents it toward the camera. She smiles while slowly and delicately swaying the handbag from side to side two or three times. The movement must be smooth, controlled and elegant, allowing the viewer to clearly see the handbag's front design, handles, gold hardware and HAPAS details. The bag should maintain realistic weight, gravity and structure.
Scene 3 – Close-up product reveal: The woman slowly brings the handbag closer toward the camera until the handbag becomes the main focus of the frame. Use a smooth cinematic push-in and shallow depth of field. Clearly showcase the white leather texture, stitching, gold hardware, HAPAS logo and hanging tag. Her face remains visible softly in the background with a pleasant smile. No distortion of the handbag as it approaches the lens.
Scene 4 – Fashion transition: Smooth elegant transition into a wider runway environment. The woman lowers the handbag naturally, holds it gracefully by the top handle or carries it on one arm, turns slightly, and prepares to walk.
Scene 5 – Catwalk finale: The woman confidently performs a slow luxury-fashion catwalk toward the camera while carrying the handbag. Natural arm movement, elegant posture, subtle hip movement, confident soft smile. Alternate between a full-body frontal shot, three-quarter angle, medium shot highlighting the handbag, and a brief side angle. The handbag moves naturally with her steps without excessive swinging.
Finish with the model stopping elegantly near the camera, slightly turning her body to present the handbag, smiling confidently while the handbag is clearly visible as the hero product.
Visual style: premium handbag commercial, luxury fashion campaign, sophisticated feminine aesthetic, clean Korean fashion advertisement style, realistic photography, high-end studio cinematography, soft warm lighting, smooth camera movement, natural skin texture, realistic fabric physics, realistic handbag physics, shallow depth of field, subtle cinematic bokeh, polished commercial look, 4K, highly detailed.
Camera: smooth dolly movement, slow push-in, medium and full-body framing, product close-up, gentle tracking shot during catwalk, stable professional camera, no sudden zoom or shaky movement.
Movement: elegant, slow, graceful, realistic and commercially polished. Avoid exaggerated gestures.
Important: preserve the woman's identity and preserve the exact handbag design from the reference images throughout every frame.

Negative prompt
Do not change the woman's face, identity, age, hairstyle or body proportions. No face morphing, no different person, no extra fingers, no deformed hands, no duplicated limbs, no unnatural walking, no robotic movements. Do not redesign the handbag, do not change its white color, logo, HAPAS lettering, hanging tag, handles, shoulder strap, gold hardware, size or proportions. No warped handbag, no melting leather, no disappearing handles, no duplicated bag, no floating bag, no incorrect logo or random text. Avoid excessive bag swinging, excessive body movement, camera shake, sudden cuts, flickering, background distortion, low resolution, cartoon look or artificial plastic skin.
